content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6-2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. Going above that doesn't add much. Spread it over 3-5 meals, each with roughly 0.3-0.4 g/kg.

💡 For example, at 70 kg that's about 110-155 g a day. Hitting the lower half of the range consistently works fine, as long as your total calories support growth.
